fact: Editorial department led by Jessica Thomas, responsible for 17 world-leading physics journals and Physics Magazine
Editorial department has approximately 70-80 direct staff members

Structure: Associate Executive Editors oversee journal portfolios by theme; each journal has a Chief Editor leading 4-20 Associate Editors; Managing Editors and Assistant Editors support journals with external editorial teams

Key responsibilities: evaluate manuscripts for significance/rigor/relevance (peer review), follow research trends, invite research and cultivate reviewer pool, champion ethics and research integrity, make physics visible and interesting
Current topical groups inviting research in: astronomy/astrophysics, biological physics, climate/sustainability, chemical physics, experimental condensed matter physics
